evidence.label: robots.txt
evidence.detail: WARN: robots.txt has rules for 1 user agent. It doesn't declare a Sitemap. Fix: Serve a plain-text /robots.txt (RFC 9309) with at least one User-agent group and a Sitemap line.

evidence.label: Content Signals
evidence.detail: WARN: robots.txt has no Content-Signal declaration. Fix: Add a Content-Signal line to robots.txt (for example `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no`) to state how AI systems may use your content.

evidence.label: Reachable by AI Agents
evidence.detail: FAIL: Blocked or challenged: ChatGPT-User (HTTP 403), OAI-SearchBot (HTTP 403), Claude-User (HTTP 403), and PerplexityBot (HTTP 403). Sent with each bot's user agent from Elmo's address, so sites that verify bots by IP may treat the real bo

evidence.label: Content Without JavaScript
evidence.detail: WARN: Homepage: 1,074 characters of text and 8 headings in the server HTML. 1 of 4 pages have little or no text or headings without JavaScript. Fix: Server-render your main content. Most AI crawlers don't run JavaScript, so a client-rendere

evidence.label: Markdown via Accept Header
evidence.detail: FAIL: No sampled page serves markdown when asked with `Accept: text/markdown` (4 pages checked). Fix: Return a markdown version of each page when a request sends `Accept: text/markdown`, with `Vary: Accept` so caches keep the two apart.

evidence.label: Markdown at .md URLs
evidence.detail: FAIL: No sampled page serves markdown at a `.md` URL (4 pages checked). Fix: Serve each page's markdown at the same path with `.md` appended (and `/index.md` for the homepage).

evidence.label: llms.txt
evidence.detail: FAIL: /llms.txt returned HTTP 404 with an HTML page. Fix: Publish /llms.txt as described at llmstxt.org: an H1 with the site name, a `>` summary, and sections of annotated markdown links.

evidence.label: Sitemap
evidence.detail: FAIL: No valid sitemap at https://www.highlandscoffee.com.vn/sitemap.xml (HTTP 404). Fix: Publish an XML sitemap listing your canonical pages, and reference it from robots.txt with a Sitemap line.

evidence.label: Discovery Link Headers
evidence.detail: WARN: The homepage sends no discovery Link header. Fix: Add an HTTP Link header (RFC 8288) to the homepage pointing at your sitemap, llms.txt (`rel="describedby"`), and markdown alternate.

evidence.label: Organization Structured Data
evidence.detail: FAIL: The homepage has no Organization JSON-LD. Fix: Add Organization JSON-LD to the homepage with name, url, logo, description, and contactPoint or address.

evidence.label: Entity Links (sameAs)
evidence.detail: FAIL: The Organization has no sameAs links. Fix: List your official profiles (LinkedIn, GitHub, Crunchbase, Wikipedia, X) in the Organization's `sameAs`, so models tie your site to the right entity.

evidence.label: Page Structured Data
evidence.detail: FAIL: Sampled pages have no content-level structured data. Fix: Mark up pages with the schema.org type that fits them: Article or BlogPosting, Product or SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, HowTo, BreadcrumbList.

evidence.label: Page Metadata
evidence.detail: FAIL: meta description missing on 4 pages, og:image missing on 2 pages, and og:type missing on 4 pages. Fix: Give every page a unique title, a meta description, a canonical link, `<html lang>`, and og:image and og:type.

evidence.detail: 154 DOM nodes, 68 accessibility nodes, 3 scripts, 3 resources

evidence.label: Third-party code
evidence.detail: No third-party origins seen in the capture window

evidence.label: Application internals
evidence.detail: 3 script chunks analysed; endpoints seen: none

evidence.label: WebMCP tools
evidence.detail: The page declares no agent-callable (WebMCP) tools

headline: AI crawlers get HTTP 403 errors, blocking them from reading the site.

findings.title: AI crawlers are blocked with HTTP 403
findings.why: ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, Claude-User, and PerplexityBot all receive HTTP 403 responses.
findings.fix: Allow AI crawler user agents to access the site without returning HTTP 403.

findings.title: Missing sitemap, llms.txt, and discovery signals
findings.why: Both /sitemap.xml and /llms.txt return HTTP 404, and robots.txt lacks a Sitemap or Content-Signal line.
findings.fix: Publish /sitemap.xml and /llms.txt, then reference them in robots.txt and HTTP Link headers.

findings.title: No structured data or entity links
findings.why: The site has no Organization JSON-LD, sameAs links, or content-level schema.org markup.
findings.fix: Add Organization JSON-LD with sameAs links on the homepage and schema.org markup on content pages.

findings.title: Missing metadata, markdown views, and full non-JS content
findings.why: All 4 sampled pages lack meta descriptions, og:type, and markdown versions, and 1 lacks non-JS text.
findings.fix: Server-render all page text, add complete metadata tags, and serve markdown via Accept headers or .md URLs.

findings.title: Page dates are missing from structured metadata
findings.why: All 4 pages show a date, but 0 include it in structured data or meta tags.
findings.fix: Add datePublished and dateModified fields to JSON-LD or meta tags on every page.
